newsitem.title: UK: Burmah up on positive Kleinwort comment.
newsitem.headline: Burmah up on positive Kleinwort comment.

text.p: Shares in British lubricants group Burmah Castrol Plc rose in early trading on Thursday after positive comment from analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, dealers said.
The stock was up 9p at 975-1/2 by 0752 GMT, against the declining trend of the market overall. Volume reached 150,903 shares.
Dealers said Kleinwort rated the stock "oversold" and argued that any earnings downgrades due to sterling strength had been factored in.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
